rules.name: MRP Declaration Screening
rules.description: Checks for visible Maximum Retail Price (MRP) declaration including taxes.

rules.name: Net Quantity Declaration Screening
rules.description: Checks for visible Net Quantity statement with standard metric units.

rules.name: Date of Manufacture/Packing/Import Screening
rules.description: Checks for visible Month and Year of manufacture, packing, or import.

rules.name: Manufacturer/Packer/Importer Identity & Address
rules.description: Checks for visible name and complete postal address of manufacturer/packer/importer.

rules.name: Consumer Care Contact Information
rules.description: Checks for visible Consumer Care details (Name, Address, Phone, or Email).

rules.name: Country of Origin (Imported Goods)
rules.description: Checks for explicit Country of Origin declaration on imported pre-packaged goods.

rules.name: Numeral Height Declaration Screening
rules.description: Checks if the font height of statutory numerals meets the Schedule II minimum requirement based on the Principal Display Panel (PDP) area.
rules.legal_reference: Rule 9 (Schedule II) Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

rules.name: Unit Sale Price (USP) Declaration and Arithmetic Validation
rules.description: Checks for the presence of the USP declaration and verifies its mathematical correctness.

rules.name: Standard Unit Validator
rules.description: Checks if the declared unit of measurement uses standard SI abbreviations.
rules.legal_reference: Rule 11 and 12 Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

rules.name: Dimensions Declaration
rules.description: Checks for visible dimensions (length, breadth, thickness, size).

rules.name: Date Chronology Validation
rules.description: Checks if the Best Before / Expiry date is logically after the Date of Manufacture / Packing.
rules.legal_reference: Logical consistency check for chronological declarations.
